children: Nvidia-backed AI data center operator Groq has invited investors to participate in a Series B round at an $8 billion pre-money valuation. According to Odaily, the proposed financing would more than double Groq’s valuation in about three months.

The fundraising effort comes as shares of data center operators CoreWeave and Nebius have recently sold off amid concerns about the sustainability of large-scale borrowing to build AI infrastructure. Late last year, Nvidia recruited Groq founder and CEO Jonathan Ross and other key employees through a $20 billion technology licensing deal.

title: Nvidia-Backed Groq Seeks Series B Funding at $8 Billion Pre-Money Valuation
